subject: general
question: Which of the following metals is less reactive than Al?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zn**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The atomic number of zinc is 30, which means it has 30 protons in its nucleus.
 
• The atomic mass of zinc is approximately 65.38 atomic mass units (amu).
 
• The electron configuration of zinc is [Ar] 3d¹⁰ 4s². It has a filled d-subshell, making it relatively stable.
 
• Melting Point: Zinc has a melting point of 419.5°C (787.1°F). Boiling Point: The boiling point of zinc is 907°C (1665°F).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Magnesium** (Mg) Atomic Number: 12, Atomic Mass: 24.305 amu.
 
• **Position in the Periodic Table**: Group: 2 (Alkaline Earth Metals), Period: 3.
 
• **Melting Point**: 650°C (1,202°F), **Boiling Point**: 1,090°C (1,994°F), **Density**: 1.738 g/cm³ at room temperature
 
• **Sodium** (Na) Atomic Number: 11, Atomic Mass: 22.989769 amu.
 
• **Position in the Periodic Table**: Group: 1 (Alkali Metals), Period: 3.
 
• **Melting Point**: 97.72°C (207.9°F), **Boiling Point**: 883°C (1,621°F), **Density**: 0.968 g/cm³ (less dense than water).
 
• **Calcium** (Ca): Atomic Number: 20, Atomic Mass: 40.078 amu.
 
• **Position in the Periodic Table**: Group: 2 (Alkaline Earth Metals), Period: 4.
 
• **Melting Point**: 842°C (1,548°F), **Boiling Point**: 1,484°C (2,703°F), **Density**: 1.54 g/cm³ at room temperature.
